examples.chinese: 那個孩子可真勇敢！連看到蛇也不害怕。
examples.pinyin: Nàge háizi kě zhēn yǒnggǎn! Lián kàn dào shé yě bú hàipà.
examples.english: That child is certainly brave! He is not even afraid when he sees a snake.

examples.chinese: 我把房間裡那條黑色繩子看成蛇，嚇了我一大跳。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bǎ fángjiān lǐ nà tiáo hēisè shéngzi kàn chéng shé, xià le wǒ yī dà tiào.
examples.english: I mistook that black rope in the room for a snake and got a big scare.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

examples.chinese: 動物的體溫不見得都是不變的，像蛇的體溫就隨著環境而變。
examples.pinyin: Dòngwù de tǐwēn bù jiàndé dōu shì bùbiàn de, xiàng shé de tǐwēn jiù suízhe huánjìng ér biàn.
examples.english: Animal body temperatures are not necessarily constant; for example, a snake's body temperature changes with the environment.

items.wordHook: an 虫(insect) curls around an 它(it) shape in the grass → 蛇(snake).

examples.chinese: 暑假的時候，我跟弟弟一起做家事。我掃地，他洗碗筷。
examples.pinyin: Shǔjià de shíhou, wǒ gēn dìdi yīqǐ zuò jiāshì. Wǒ sǎo dì, tā xǐ wǎnkuài.
examples.english: During summer vacation, I do housework together with my younger brother. I sweep the floor, and he washes the dishes.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說要把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的，這樣才能開開心心地過年。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō yào bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, zhèyàng cái néng kāikāixīnxīn de guònián.
examples.english: Mom said to clean the room spotlessly clean, so that we can celebrate the New Year happily.

examples.chinese: 媽媽說要把房間打掃得乾乾淨淨的，這樣才能開開心心地過年。
examples.pinyin: Māma shuō yào bǎ fángjiān dǎsǎo de gāngānjìngjìng de, zhèyàng cái néng kāikāixīnxīn de guònián.
examples.english: Mom said to clean the room spotlessly clean, so that we can celebrate the New Year happily.

examples.chinese: 陳可欣是一個勇敢、樂觀的人，什麼麻煩、困難的問題都不怕。
examples.pinyin: Chén Kěxīn shì yí ge yǒnggǎn, lèguān de rén, shénme máfan, kùnnan de wèntí dōu bú pà.
examples.english: Chen Kexin is a brave and optimistic person; she is not afraid of any troublesome or difficult problems.

examples.chinese: 一般人都喜歡跟性格溫柔、樂觀的人交朋友。
examples.pinyin: Yībān rén dōu xǐhuān gēn xìnggé wēnróu, lèguān de rén jiāo péngyǒu.
examples.english: Most people like to make friends with people who have a gentle and optimistic personality.

examples.chinese: 哥哥的性格開朗、樂觀，遇到麻煩也不會往壞處想。
examples.pinyin: Gēge de xìnggé kāilǎng, lèguān, yùdào máfan yě bù huì wǎng huàichù xiǎng.
examples.english: My older brother has a cheerful and optimistic personality; even when he encounters trouble, he won't think about the bad side.

examples.chinese: 樂觀的人會積極挑戰困難，就算無法成功也不會感到失望。
examples.pinyin: Lèguān de rén huì jījí tiǎozhàn kùnnán, jiùsuàn wúfǎ chénggōng yě bù huì gǎndào shīwàng.
examples.english: Optimistic people will actively challenge difficulties; even if they cannot succeed, they will not feel disappointed.

examples.chinese: 那兩家便利商店同樣提供客人休息的座位，但是第二家的空間比第一家大多了。林媽媽總是給她的雙胞胎女兒穿同樣顏色、同樣大小的衣服。
examples.pinyin: Nà liǎng jiā biànlì shāngdiàn tóngyàng tígōng kèrén xiūxi de zuòwèi, dànshì dì èr jiā de kōngjiān bǐ dì yī jiā dà duō le. Lín māma zǒngshì gěi tā de shuāngbāotāi nǚ'ér chuān tóngyàng yánsè, tóngyàng dàxiǎo de yīfu.
examples.english: Those two convenience stores similarly provide seats for customers to rest, but the second store's space is much larger than the first's. Mrs. Lin always dresses her twin daughters in clothes of the same color and the same size.

examples.chinese: 我伯伯說，讀書與做人同樣重要，也是一輩子的事。與人溝通時，最重要的是讓對方清楚了解你想表達的意思。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bóbo shuō, dúshū yǔ zuòrén tóngyàng zhòngyào, yě shì yībèizi de shì. Yǔ rén gōutōng shí, zuì zhòngyào de shì ràng duìfāng qīngchǔ liǎojiě nǐ xiǎng biǎodá de yìsi.
examples.english: My uncle says that studying and being a good person are equally important, and are lifelong matters. When communicating with others, the most important thing is to let the other person clearly understand what you want to express.

examples.chinese: 教授學生做人的道理與教授知識同樣重要。
examples.pinyin: Jiàoshòu xuéshēng zuòrén de dàolǐ yǔ jiàoshòu zhīshì tóngyàng zhòngyào.
examples.english: Instructing students in the principles of how to conduct themselves is just as important as instructing them in knowledge.

examples.chinese: 警察的工作主要是保護民眾，讓好人不被傷害。
examples.pinyin: Jǐngchá de gōngzuò zhǔyào shì bǎohù mínzhòng, ràng hǎorén bù bèi shānghài.
examples.english: The police's job is mainly to protect the public, so that good people are not hurt.

examples.chinese: 真正的朋友會幫助你、關心你，是絕對不會傷害你的。青少年常因為不了解而誤會父母的教育方式，或許等他們長大了，就能真正明白了。
examples.pinyin: Zhēnzhèng de péngyǒu huì bāngzhù nǐ, guānxīn nǐ, shì juéduì bù huì shānghài nǐ de. Qīngshàonián cháng yīnwèi bù liǎojiě ér wùhuì fùmǔ de jiàoyù fāngshì, huòxǔ děng tāmen zhǎngdà le, jiù néng zhēnzhèng míngbai le.
examples.english: True friends will help you and care about you; they will absolutely not hurt you. Teenagers often misunderstand their parents' way of education because they don't understand; perhaps when they grow up, they will truly understand.

examples.chinese: 有人設計出地震的警告系統，減少了地震帶來的傷害，這樣的成就真是了不起。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shèjì chū dìzhèn de jǐnggào xìtǒng, jiǎnshǎo le dìzhèn dàilái de shānghài, zhèyàng de chéngjiù zhēn shì liǎobuqǐ.
examples.english: Someone designed an earthquake warning system that reduced the damage caused by earthquakes; such an achievement is truly amazing.

examples.chinese: 手機雖然使生活更便利，但過度使用也可能傷害身心健康。人類過度的發展活動，已對動植物的生活環境造成嚴重破壞。
examples.pinyin: Shǒujī suīrán shǐ shēnghuó gèng biànlì, dàn guòdù shǐyòng yě kěnéng shānghài shēnxīn jiànkāng. Rénlèi guòdù de fāzhǎn huódòng, yǐ duì dòngzhíwù de shēnghuó huánjìng zàochéng yánzhòng pòhuài.
examples.english: Although mobile phones make life more convenient, excessive use may also harm physical and mental health. Humans' excessive development activities have already caused serious damage to the living environments of animals and plants.

examples.chinese: 跟朋友飲酒是一件開心的事，不過飲酒過度卻可能傷害身體。
examples.pinyin: Gēn péngyǒu yǐn jiǔ shì yí jiàn kāixīn de shì, búguò yǐn jiǔ guòdù què kěnéng shānghài shēntǐ.
examples.english: Drinking alcohol with friends is a happy thing, but excessive drinking may harm your health.

examples.chinese: 那家工廠排出的黑煙不只氣味難聞，更可怕的是可能對肺部造成傷害。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā gōngchǎng pái chū de hēiyān bùzhǐ qìwèi nánwén, gèng kěpà de shì kěnéng duì fèibù zàochéng shānghài.
examples.english: The black smoke emitted by that factory not only smells bad, but even more frighteningly, it may cause harm to the lungs.

examples.chinese: 潮溼的居住環境不僅使家具不容易保養，並且更可能傷害人體健康。
examples.pinyin: Cháoshī de jūzhù huánjìng bùjǐn shǐ jiājù bù róngyì bǎoyǎng, bìngqiě gèng kěnéng shānghài réntǐ jiànkāng.
examples.english: A damp living environment not only makes it difficult to maintain furniture, but is also more likely to harm human health.

items.wordHook: Combining 傷(injure) and 害(cause): 傷害 means hurt.

examples.chinese: 那個小偷趁著觀眾看表演的時候偷東西，結果當場就被安全人員抓了。
examples.pinyin: Nàge xiǎotōu chènzhe guānzhòng kàn biǎoyǎn de shíhou tōu dōngxi, jiéguǒ dāngchǎng jiù bèi ānquán rényuán zhuā le.
examples.english: That thief took advantage of the audience watching the performance to steal things, and as a result, he was caught on the spot by security personnel.

examples.chinese: 他的頭部被棒球打中並當場昏迷，還好幾分鐘後就醒過來了。
examples.pinyin: Tā de tóubù bèi bàngqiú dǎ zhòng bìng dāngchǎng hūnmí, háihǎo jǐ fēnzhōng hòu jiù xǐng guòlái le.
examples.english: He was hit in the head by a baseball and lost consciousness on the spot; fortunately, he woke up after a few minutes.

examples.chinese: 張小姐很膽小，看到車禍現場有人流了很多血，當場就昏倒了。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiǎojiě hěn dǎnxiǎo, kàn dào chēhuò xiànchǎng yǒu rén liú le hěn duō xiě, dāngchǎng jiù hūndǎo le.
examples.english: Miss Zhang is very timid; when she saw someone bleeding a lot at the car accident scene, she fainted on the spot.

examples.chinese: 哎喲，已經半夜一點多了！我們就別再加班寫產品計畫了，等明天再繼續吧！
examples.pinyin: Āiyō, yǐjīng bànyè yìdiǎn duō le! Wǒmen jiù bié zài jiābān xiě chǎnpǐn jìhuà le, děng míngtiān zài jìxù ba!
examples.english: Woah, it's already past one in the morning! Let's stop working overtime to write the product plan, and continue tomorrow!

examples.chinese: 醫生說，要是睡前喝了太多水，早上起來時臉就會有點兒腫。
examples.pinyin: Yīshēng shuō, yàoshi shuì qián hē le tài duō shuǐ, zǎoshang qǐlái shí liǎn jiù huì yǒudiǎnr zhǒng.
examples.english: The doctor said that if you drink too much water before bed, your face will be a bit swollen when you get up in the morning.

examples.chinese: 這桌喜酒有很多海鮮，但我只能吃魚，其他種類的海鮮都會讓我皮膚紅腫(inflamed)。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhuō xǐjiǔ yǒu hěn duō hǎixiān, dàn wǒ zhǐ néng chī yú, qítā zhǒnglèi de hǎixiān dōu huì ràng wǒ pífū hóngzhǒng.
examples.english: This table of wedding wine has a lot of seafood, but I can only eat fish; other types of seafood all make my skin swell and turn red.

examples.chinese: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàtiān yī huódòng hàn jiù liú ge bùtíng de nǚxìng lái shuō, huàzhuāng shízài shì jiàn máfan shì.
examples.english: For women who sweat nonstop as soon as they move in summer, putting on makeup is really a troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 早上在草地上散步，突然看見一條蛇經過，害得我一直流冷汗。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang zài cǎodì shàng sànbù, tūrán kànjiàn yī tiáo shé jīngguò, hàide wǒ yīzhí liú lěnghàn.
examples.english: While walking on the grass this morning, I suddenly saw a snake pass by, which made me keep breaking out in a cold sweat.

examples.chinese: 我的鞋底快要掉下來了，得去店裡請人把它粘起來。他不管我忙不忙，老是黏著我聊天，讓我覺得有點煩。夏天的時候容易流汗，讓衣服變得黏黏的，真不舒服。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xiédǐ kuàiyào diào xiàlái le, děi qù diànlǐ qǐng rén bǎ tā zhān qǐlái. Tā bùguǎn wǒ máng bù máng, lǎoshì niánzhe wǒ liáotiān, ràng wǒ juéde yǒudiǎn fán. Xiàtiān de shíhou róngyì liúhàn, ràng yīfu biànde niánnián de, zhēn bù shūfu.
examples.english: My shoe sole is about to fall off; I need to go to the shop and ask someone to glue it back on. Regardless of whether I'm busy or not, he's always clinging to me to chat, which makes me feel a bit annoyed. In summer, it's easy to sweat, making clothes sticky, which is really uncomfortable.

examples.chinese: 我不太喜歡流很多汗，所以不常跑步，比較喜歡在公園散步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bù tài xǐhuān liú hěn duō hàn, suǒyǐ bù cháng pǎobù, bǐjiào xǐhuān zài gōngyuán sànbù.
examples.english: I don't really like to sweat a lot, so I don't run often; I prefer to take walks in the park.

items.wordHook: The 氵(water) beads on your skin turn 干(dry) as they evaporate, leaving the salt of 汗(perspiration).
合(combine) + 歡(happy) + 山(mountain) → Hehuan Mountain, a mountain of shared joy.
Combining 招(summon) and 待(entertain): 招待 means treat.
A steady hand takes a 肀(brush) to write 一(one) line above the 日(sun) → a new 書(book).
Combining 玉(jade) and 米(rice): 玉米 means corn.
a 木(tree) branch frames a 目(eye) staring back → 相(photo).
